----------\n\nexport function adjustedXp(req, res) {\n  const body = requireBody(req);\n  if (body.error) return badRequest(res, body.error);\n\n  const party = Array.isArray(body.value?.party) ? function recordSessionAttendance(req, res, campaignId, sessionId) {\n  const campaign = db.getCampaign(campaignId);\n  if (!campaign) return notFound(res);\n\n  const session =
